title: Research/pr1048 certified two transports
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

PR1048 compares profiles at a fixed exponent without establishing the ordering of their actual roots. This package reproduces the maintainers' counterexample, supplies a certified surcharge-inclusive reference-root comparator, and independently excludes improvement by at most two transports in the explicitly frozen PR589 domain.

The complete census contains **1,452,893 legal single transports** and **59,998 distinct overlapping ordered operation pairs**, giving **1,379,084 final pair representatives**. Singles have 1,227,676 exact ties and 225,217 strictly worse outcomes; pair representatives have 1,282,055 exact ties and 97,029 strictly worse outcomes. Both implementations report **zero better and zero unresolved cases**. Repeated-operation and register-disjoint pairs are covered by the accompanying reduction proof; operation-pair counts are not literal path counts.

The comparator encloses signed `J_delta` over the entire verified reference-root bracket using outward rational transcendental bounds. It fails closed on uncertain signs. This is a finite audit, with no new construction or κ improvement. Three or more moves, growing catalogues, arbitrary subspaces, other circuit identities, illegal intermediates, and full multiplication-theorem/native/precision obligations remain outside scope.

Start with [the result and exact domain](research/pr1048-complete-feasibility/README.md) and [the proof](research/pr1048-complete-feasibility/PROOF.md).

## Task and overlap

Explicit Brian Ross assignment: repair PR1048 pricing and independently check post-first-move coverage. Scope was refined from a bounded diagnostic slice to complete exclusion in the declared frozen domain: 3,064 elementary A/B operations; frames from the original 636-frame catalogue plus each current slot's own rational lower-span closure; legal intermediates and resulting retained COPY constraints.

Base: `bce54fb3f895cbe5cd4c0eb477c3afeed100190f`. Retained dependencies: #1048 at `07730cd8302c378607259a9ad0efb73e0b57a2f2` and #1182 at `0213b8911bfeefd5c81ddf320bac6a0fb7e86215`, with unchanged sources and notices. Four additive research directories; no existing upstream source or selected construction changes. Earlier package narratives and receipts are preserved as historical evidence.

Ian Libânio's #933 at `b9348c6907516e55dc07e135ad4d7a480d4f9840` already reports broader relocation/all-frame negative results and a 2,000-pair independent sample. This contribution claims no first-negative priority or equivalence with that larger domain. Its added value is corrected reference-root pricing, the explicit pair-projection completeness argument, and a full separate replay of this narrower domain. See [publication checks and overlap](research/pr1048-complete-feasibility/PUBLICATION.md).

## Validation

CPython 3.13.2 on macOS. Reproduction commands and pinned receipts are in the README and [independent review](research/pr1048-complete-feasibility/REVIEW.md).

- All 36 mandatory input pins pass. Separate implementations agree on every single-operation domain, the full pair transcript, all 93 pair delta/count/status records, and enclosing price intervals.
- Complete primary/independent pair scans took 372.174/125.896 seconds. A fresh isolated independent full replay on the submission base took 119.384 seconds and matched the saved complete result.
- Transcript SHA256: `b39d6d23210ab7eee24c04e165b078e39ea00053e4be4b523f7c793e24b79679`.
- Existing root-ordering and bracket defects reproduce. Semantic corruption controls fail closed. A synthetic strict-improvement control demonstrates why equal first-state profiles cannot justify discarding continuation neighborhoods; it is not an improving PR589 witness.
- `python3 -I -B scripts/verify_selected_result.py` and diff whitespace checks pass.

No full selected cold replay, native admission, repository-wide historical suites, hosted CI, proof assistant, or independent human proof review is claimed.

## Credit

Prepared by Brian Ross with OpenAI Codex assistance, including separate GPT-6 Astra review and rerun. Credit flemhhh's original search; Douglas Colkitt/the maintainers' existing counterexample; woklerx's reused #1182 bracket repair; Ian Libânio's #933; and DreamingOfClouds, eumemic, and retained supplier lineage.

Brian Ross's [Krenn independent verifier](https://github.com/brianross93/Krenn/blob/ab446724a61a293a3268c63b9e9e721c6a360561/experiments/krenn_quantum_graph/independent_verifier.py) and [semantic-corruption tests](https://github.com/brianross93/Krenn/blob/ab446724a61a293a3268c63b9e9e721c6a360561/tests/test_krenn_artifacts.py), plus [ThetaTwist exact-arithmetic discipline](https://github.com/brianross93/thetatwist/blob/b4ec6c13088b89961834cc675b44b81372199b02/src/thetatwist/core.py), inform the methodology. This is methodological adaptation, with no copied code from those projects or PR933. Existing licenses are retained; new material is Apache-2.0.

## Open next questions

The [smallest useful follow-up](research/pr1048-complete-feasibility/README.md#open-next-questions) is a correspondence audit of PR933's first-slot equivalence and post-first neighborhoods against the pair-specific projection here. Different move primitives and global frame reoptimization prevent assuming equivalence. No defect in PR933 is asserted; no larger search is justified without a new completeness argument.
